title: VnExpress Marathon Hai Phong 2026 Review: Vietnam's Coastal Marathon in Do Son

meta_description: The VnExpress Marathon Hai Phong 2026: December 13 in Do Son, Hai Phong, Vietnam. Full marathon, half, 10K, and 5K from Vietnam's premier race series — a coastal race reviewed.
dek: Set for 13 December 2026 in Do Son, Hai Phong, this VnExpress Marathon brings Vietnam's premier race series to the northern coast. Four distances from 5K to full marathon. Registration isn't open yet, but the organiser pedigree is among the strongest in the country.
verdict: The VnExpress Marathon Hai Phong 2026 brings Vietnam's most established race series to Do Son — a coastal peninsula in Hai Phong, northern Vietnam's port city — for a four-distance event (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K). VnExpress, in partnership with FPT Online, runs the country's largest marathon series, and their events are among the most professionally produced in Vietnam: chip timing, well-stocked aid stations, entertainment zones, and medal design that incorporates local heritage. The December date in northern Vietnam is cool and dry — markedly different from the tropical conditions of the southern races. Registration isn't open yet, but for a VnExpress race, the operational template is proven.

sections.heading: The Series: VnExpress Marathon
paragraphs: VnExpress Marathon is Vietnam's largest and most professionally-run race series, with events in Nha Trang, Hanoi, Da Nang, Hai Phong, and Ho Chi Minh City. [1] A VnExpress race comes with certain expectations: chip timing, well-spaced aid stations, entertainment zones along the route, and medals that incorporate local cultural landmarks. The Hai Phong edition brings that production quality to Vietnam's northern coast.

sections.heading: The Venue: Do Son, Hai Phong
paragraphs: Do Son is a coastal peninsula and beach resort area roughly 20km southeast of Hai Phong city centre, known for its pine-covered hills, sandy beaches, and views over the Gulf of Tonkin. [1] The coastal roads provide a scenic, relatively flat course with sea breezes, and the December date in northern Vietnam delivers cool, dry conditions — morning temperatures in the mid-teens to low 20s Celsius, among the best running weather in the country.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a VnExpress-quality marathon in northern Vietnam with coastal scenery and cool December conditions, Hai Phong is worth tracking. Watch bestmarathon.vn for registration updates. The 2026 edition is set for 13 December in Do Son, Hai Phong. [1]
